fields.title: web-development
fields.description: "Master modern front-end and back-end web technologies. Learn to build responsive, dynamic web applications, scalable APIs, and full-stack solutions using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Django, React, and modern web frameworks."

fields.title: mobile-development
fields.description: "Learn to design, build, and deploy native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android. Master leading tools and frameworks including Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, and mobile UI design patterns."

fields.title: data-science
fields.description: "Transform raw data into actionable insights and business intelligence. Explore data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, and interactive visualization using Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, and Tableau."

fields.title: devops-cloud
fields.description: "Bridge the gap between development and operations. Master continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, and scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud."

fields.title: ai-machine-learning
fields.description: "Dive into the forefront of artificial intelligence. Learn supervised and unsupervised learning, deep neural networks, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision using frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-Learn."

fields.title: cybersecurity
fields.description: "Protect critical systems, networks, and data from digital threats. Learn network security, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, ethical hacking techniques, cryptography, and modern defensive security best practices."

fields.title: game-development
fields.description: "Bring creative gameplay and interactive worlds to life. Master 2D and 3D game design, physics engines, character animation, shader programming, and game logic using Unity, Unreal Engine, C#, and C++."

fields.title: software-engineering
fields.description: "Level up your foundational computer science and engineering craft. Master data structures, algorithms, system design, object-oriented design patterns, clean architecture, and test-driven development (TDD)."

fields.title: ui-ux-design
fields.description: "Craft intuitive, accessible, and user-centric digital experiences. Learn the complete design lifecycle from user research and wireframing to interactive prototyping and component design systems using Figma and modern design tools."

fields.title: databases
fields.description: "Design, manage, and optimize relational and NoSQL database systems. Learn complex SQL querying, indexing, schema design, data integrity, and high-performance database tuning for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB."

fields.title: other
fields.description: "Explore specialized skills, emerging technologies, developer productivity tools, and interdisciplinary topics that support your lifelong tech learning journey."
